_help: Fill every null. 'health' feeds this lane's own frame check; 'common' feeds any gate that declares that argument; 'lanes' overrides or adds per lane (true = bare flag). A gate with a null left in it is reported UNMEASURED, never skipped silently. Check each lane's INTEGRATION.md: 'reference'/'candidate' are run DIRECTORIES for the aircraft lanes and PNG files for the others, so set them per lane where they differ.
